items.desc:
Proposed way forward for OCHA CT and support
  • - Drop OCHA-specific control tower deployment (for now): Avoid forcing adoption in high-pressure environments to mitigate risk of rejection or ineffective usage
  • - Continue development as a corporate control tower solution: There is a strong interest from OER in the concept as a future corporate capability. However, it should be piloted in selected countries with sufficient capacity, not OCHA-heavy contexts
  • - Provide targeted support to OER (not tied to a specific system)
    • If allowed, we can review their internal tool and provide input on improvements to create more SC visibility over the OCHA projects 
    • Participate in cross-functional coordination mechanisms as CSLO support capacity (or part of the CSL support to act as one force)
    • Focus on solving concrete SCM issues rather than pushing tooling
